newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia police seize rebel dynamite shipment.
newsitem.headline: Colombia police seize rebel dynamite shipment.

text.p: Colombian police seized more than four tonnes of dynamite destined for leftist guerrillas in an operation near Bogota on Thursday, the authorities said.

The National Liberation Army (ELN), Colombia's second-largest rebel force, planned to use the explosives in a wave of attacks on military bases and oil facilities in the northeast of the country, National Police Chief Gen. Rosso Jose Serrano said.

"This dynamite was going to be divided up between several ELN commandos. This is the first time we have seized such a large amount of dynamite. The guerrillas could have caused untold damage with these explosives," Serrano said.
The load was discovered in a truck amid a cargo of food and ceramics near the town of Guacheta, about 50 miles (70 km) northeast of Bogota. The truck driver was arrested, police said.
